newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close higher on speculations.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close higher on speculations.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Tuesday, mainly on speculative buying of textile stocks and select blue chips, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 12.55 points, or 0.85 percent, to end at 1,493.92. Gainers beat losers 242 to 95.

"Sentiment was positive and speculative buying in textile stocks on reports of a possible government relief package for this sector pushed the index up," dealer Sajad Mankani said. "But the gains are temporary as fundamentals remain unchanged."
